# Everstead

> Everstead is a UK platform that helps families securely organise their accounts, documents, instructions, and final wishes in one place — so loved ones know exactly what to do when it matters most. Set up in minutes; shared only with the people you choose.

Everstead Digital Ltd, London, UK. UK GDPR compliant · ICO registered · AES-256 encryption.

## What Everstead does
- A secure vault for bank accounts, investments, insurance, property, and digital accounts
- Document storage for wills, deeds, and important paperwork
- Trusted people: invite family members, executors, or advisers to access only the sections you choose
- Step-by-step instructions and final wishes for loved ones
- Human-verified release: a trusted person only gains access after Everstead verifies a death or incapacity report — never on a silent or automatic trigger
- An optional AI assistant that helps you set things up; AI features can be turned off per account

## Plans
- Essential — from £3.99/month (or £3.19/month billed annually)
- Family — from £9.99/month (or £7.99/month billed annually); two private vaults under one subscription
- Adviser — for financial advisers and estate planners (pricing on application)
- 14-day free trial; no card required to start
